title: QUIC RFC 9369 Version 2 Static Floor Work Item
summary: Close the RFC 9369 QUIC v2 static floor by proving version recognition, v2 Initial protection, and v2 Retry integrity with focused tests, fuzz coverage, and benchmark evidence.
planned_changes:
- Add `SPEC-QUIC-RFC9369.json`, `ARC-QUIC-RFC9369-0001.json`, `WI-QUIC-RFC9369-0001.json`, and `VER-QUIC-RFC9369-0001.json`.
- Add requirement-home tests for v2 packet-type mapping, v2 Initial packet protection, and v2 Retry integrity.
- Extend the transport-parameter, header-parsing, Initial-packet-protection, and Retry-integrity benchmark suites with explicit v2 scenarios.
- Extend fuzz coverage so the packet parser and transport-parameter codec continue to exercise version-aware shapes while the v2 floor is under proof.
- Keep the RFC 9368 compatible-version restart/selection flow out of scope for this slice and leave it in the gap ledger for a separate runtime-behavior pass.
verification_plan: Run the RFC 9369 requirement-home tests, run the packet-parser, Initial packet-protection, Retry-integrity, and transport-parameter unit tests, run the transport-parameter/header-parsing/Initial-protection/Retry-integrity benchmark dry runs, validate SpecTrace JSON, refresh the QUIC requirement coverage triage, and run `git diff --check`.
out_of_scope: HTTP/3, CONNECT-UDP, MASQUE, and other higher-layer uses of the versioning family.
Application-layer adaptation beyond the transport helper floor.
completion_notes: Complete. The QUIC v2 static floor now has requirement-home, fuzz, benchmark, and trace-validation evidence, while the compatible-version runtime follow-up remains separate.
